Name: Adjustable Animal Prices
Author: scarboy17
Description:
Adjust the price of animals and pets to something more affordable or if you want a challenge set them to something more expensive.

For coop and barn animals you can adjust the purchase and sell price to the value you like. Enter half the value (As marnie charges 2x the value entered.) for the animal in the settings box and click save. Then if in marnie's place exit and re-enter for the price to take effect.

For pet adoptions you can choose a modifier which can make pets cost as little as $4000 or much higher. Available multipliers: 0.01, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0, 2.0, 3.0 (default: 1.0). Which work out roughly to be 99% discount, 90% discount, 75% discount, 50% discount, 25% discount, Full price, Double Price, Triple Price,

 

[u]How to install[/u]
[list]
[*]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Smapi 4.0.0 or later[/url].
[*]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher 2.0.0 or later[/url].
[*]Make sure that the game is on at least 1.6.
[*]Download the main file and extract into your mods folder﻿﻿.
[*]Optional but highly recommended [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to be able to edit prices ingame.
[/list]
